description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Snubhorn Sentry.
When Snubhorn Sentry dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill cards equal to Snubhorn Sentry's power.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Cast Snubhorn Sentry from your graveyard by paying {W} plus exiling three other cards from your graveyard.
Repeat.
